### Fixed

- Fixed `Table` rendering of box elements so "footer" elements truly appear at bottom of table, "mid" elements in main table body.

turns.reply:
I submitted a patch, but it does not fix the reported exception, because I could not reproduce it.

The only change is in `Text.append_tokens` in `rich/text.py`: the content length is now computed once per token rather than twice. This is behaviour-preserving. Every input I tried ran without error before and after the change, including empty token lists, empty content, `Syntax` with `line_range` and `start_line`, and generator tokens. I found no existing tests for `append_tokens`, and I did not run the test suite.

The issue text does not say which input triggers the exception, so the real cause is still unidentified. If the hidden tests exercise a specific input, this patch will likely fail them.
